failures: WebSearch only returns AI-written summaries; it cannot index the interior of books. For Kappers/Huber/Crosby 1936, Nieuwenhuys/ten Donkelaar/Nicholson 1998, Butler & Hodos 2005, Kuhlenbeck, Striedter, Kaas, Sarnat & Netsky, Smeets et al. 1983, Kemali & Braitenberg and O'Rahilly & Muller no passage mentioning the paraphysis was returned; these are recorded as catalogue-level records only (index check required).

Nomenclature sources (Terminologia Neuroanatomica, Terminologia Embryologica, Nomina Anatomica Avium, Nomina Anatomica Veterinaria, Nomina Embryologica Veterinaria): no entry for paraphysis was surfaced or confirmed; PDF/database interiors could not be searched (egress policy blocks direct access; WebFetch not used).

Spanish/Portuguese anatomy and embryology texts (Testut-Latarjet, Rouviere-Delmas, RANM dictionary of medical terms, UNAM theses): only catalogue records or no hits; no passage using 'parafisis'/'parafise' from a textbook was retrieved. The only Portuguese source found is a UFRGS dissertation on the turtle paraphysis.

Springer article 10.1007/BF00225570 repeatedly appeared in paraphysis searches but could not be identified (WebSearch returned unrelated pages); mcp__PubMed__convert_article_ids returned RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED, so the DOI could not be resolved.

Belgian Journal of Zoology 2004 134(1) turtle paraphysis paper: two WebSearch summaries give conflicting authorship (Winkelmann et al. pp 25-30 versus Henin, Huart & Rondeux pp 3); PubMed citation lookup returned NOT_FOUND. Recorded once with Winkelmann et al., flagged unverified.

PubMed lookup_article_by_citation returned NOT_FOUND for Warren 1917, Bailey 1916, Warren 1905, Ueck et al. 1989 and the Belgian J Zool 2004 paper; these are recorded with bibliographic_verified=false.

WebSearch summaries conflict on whether Holmgren 1959 (Breviora) compares Protopterus with Ceratodus/Acipenser and on whether Hines 1923 describes the paraphysis; the contested statements are not used as excerpts and are flagged in notes.
carlgans.org page listing Biology of the Reptilia contents has a spam/casino page title (possible compromised site); the Quay chapter pagination (245-406) rests on one secondary citation only.

Several historical items (Dexter 1903, Warren 1905/1911/1917, Bailey 1916, Johnston 1909, Hines 1923, Reese 1910, Dendy 1911) are known only through UNSW Embryology wiki transcriptions, Smithsonian/BHL catalogue pages or reference lists as reported by WebSearch summaries; page/volume details are as stated there and unverified.

Spanish-language clinical articles on colloid cyst (medigraphic Medicina Sur 2001, Gaceta Medica de Mexico 2004, Anales de Radiologia Mexico 2013, UNAM thesis on CT/MR frequency, Revista de Neurocirugia items) surfaced but titles/authors were not shown and no 'parafisis' text was confirmed; not recorded.
No Scite or Elicit tools were called. Wiley Scholar Gateway was not part of this channel.
